title: Quantifying the Cross-sectoral Intersecting Discrepancies within Multiple Groups Using Latent Class Analysis Towards Fairness
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure aspects of faith/religion; it quantifies cross-sectoral intersecting discrepancies among ethnic groups using survey and census data.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report findings related to religion. The findings focus on quantifying discrepancies between different ethnic groups in the UK across sectors like health, energy, and housing.
